description: The drafting-partner agent dispatches research-librarian when evidence is needed before a drafting run begins.

cases.given: drafting-partner is invoked for a chapter and the evidence log lacks entries for the chapter topic
cases.expect: research-librarian agent is dispatched to gather evidence before the drafting run begins

cases.given: drafting-partner determines that source coverage is insufficient for the planned argument
cases.expect: research-librarian is dispatched to populate evidence-log.md with relevant EV- entries
